page.title: Consent for {{name}}
page.description: Who agreed to be contacted, on which channel, and when. Mustang sends only on a channel with consent.
page.not_found: This customer does not exist or is not in your dealership.
page.opted_out_note: {{channel}} is blocked: this contact replied STOP or unsubscribed. Only the customer can lift it, by texting START.

record.title: Record consent
record.description: Write down what the customer agreed to. Consent is for one phone number or email on one channel.
record.no_contact_phone: This customer has no phone number. Add one before recording text or call consent.
record.no_contact_email: This customer has no email. Add one before recording email consent.
record.wording_placeholder: The words on the form or what you read to them

revoke.title: Revoke {{channel}} consent for {{contact}}?
revoke.description: Mustang stops sending on this channel to this contact at once. The record stays in the history.
revoke.reason_placeholder: Optional, e.g. asked us to stop calling

suppressions.title: Opt-outs
suppressions.description: Contacts of your customers that replied STOP or unsubscribed, at any dealership on Mustang. Nobody can send to them until they text START.

error.contact_not_on_customer: This contact is not one of the customer's. Add it to the customer first.
error.invalid_captured_at: Enter a valid date and time.
error.captured_at_in_future: Consent cannot be captured in the future.
error.customer_not_found: This customer does not exist or is not in your dealership.
error.consent_not_found: This consent record no longer exists.
